通过参数`size`控制输入框尺寸规格。.en-us: Use `size` to set the input size.

通过参数`variant`控制输入框形态变体。.en-us: Use `variant` to choose the input variant.

通过参数`bordered`控制输入框是否渲染边框。.en-us: Use `bordered` to control whether the input has a border.

通过参数`disabled`控制输入框是否呈现禁用状态。.en-us: Use `disabled` to control the input's disabled state.

通过参数`readOnly`控制输入框是否呈现只读状态。.en-us: Use `readOnly` to control the input's read-only state.

通过参数`status`控制输入框显示强制校验状态。.en-us: Use `status` to force a validation status on the input.

通过参数`allowClear`控制输入框是否添加内容清空图标。.en-us: Use `allowClear` to control whether the input shows a clear icon.

通过参数`addonBefore`、`addonAfter`为输入框添加额外的前.en-us: Use `addonBefore` and `addonAfter` to add elements outside the input.

通过参数`prefix`、`suffix`为输入框添加额外的内嵌前/后置元素。.en-us: Use `prefix` and `suffix` to embed elements inside the input.

通过参数`maxLength`控制输入框最大可输入内容长度。.en-us: Use `maxLength` to limit input text length.

通过参数`showCount`控制是否展示已输入字符数量。.en-us: Use `showCount` to display the entered character count.

通过参数`countFormat`自定义已输入内容计数的正则表达式规则。.en-us: Use `countFormat` to define a custom regular expression for character counting.

通过参数`autoSize`控制文本域输入框的高度自适应相关功能。.en-us: Use `autoSize` to configure automatic textarea height.

通过回调函数监听`md5Value`变化，实现对已输入内容的**md5**加密监.en-us: Monitor `md5Value` for the **MD5** hash of the input content.

通过回调函数监听`nSubmit`变化，实现对输入框内`enter`键事件的监听.en-us: Monitor `nSubmit` for `enter` key events in the input.

通过回调函数监听`nClicksSearch`变化，实现对输入框搜索按钮点击事件.en-us: Monitor `nClicksSearch` for input search button clicks.

通过参数`emptyAsNone`控制空内容的赋值策略。.en-us: Use `emptyAsNone` to control the value assigned for empty content.
